scan.note: Technical signals only. Continuous visual review and user approval remain separate.

visual_review.method: All132 output thumbnails,25 larger whole-frame samples,5 face samples;23 transition/boundary samples including all18 dissolve frames.

visual_review.limits: No assistant continuous normal-speed playback. User comfort, daily-magazine impression, originality and whole-film acceptance pending. No audience or sustainable-budget conclusions.
